integrity: Exact algebraic proof with an independent finite-dimensional checker. The generic GHZ-diagonal all-PPT/full-separability theorem and the homogeneous bulk threshold are prior work. No independent priority certification or independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Single exceptional isotropic local depolarizer, balanced GHZ input, n>=2 and visibilities strictly in (0,1). Strict critical-window regimes only; equality remains unresolved at the next order. NPT is not genuine multipartite entanglement.
title: Parity-resonant optimal bipartitions of a singly defective noisy GHZ state
